name: Ayakashi Koi Gikyoku
source:
On a night when the stars and moon are sparkling――
The protagonist is visiting a club where a low vibration is rhythmically reverberating everywhere. The band that's playing tonight is a unique five member visual kei band where all the members have fox ears called "Fox Ear".

When she hears their song, the Magatama that she received a long time ago starts to give off a light. Losing consciousness because of the light, the protagonist is carried backstage to the Fox Ear dressing room. They urge her to hand over the Magatama, but as if it's protecting her it starts to give off a light again... Realizing that stealing it is impossible the five of them surrender to the protagonist who holds the Magatama――

[Translated from Google Play]
translation:
群星与月亮闪耀的夜晚——

主人公来到一家俱乐部，低沉振动有节奏地回响。今晚演出的是独特的五人视觉系乐队“Fox Ear”，每位成员都长着狐狸耳朵。

听到他们的歌时，主人公很久以前收到的勾玉开始发光。她因光芒失去意识，被带到Fox Ear后台更衣室。五人要求她交出勾玉，但勾玉仿佛保护她，再次发光……意识到无法夺取后，五人向持有勾玉的主人公臣服。

[译自Google Play]
